description: Expected observations for the desktop walking-skeleton native smoke (run.mjs). Values come from T3's G10 checklist (a jsdom replay of the same models); the five row and N1 values below were set to the native observations by the owner's ruling of 2026-10-24 (G10; causes: #1461 adds 15 rows per member per case, #1387 E14 removes the dense parity row per case, #1387 E15 is the correctly rounded norm3). The bundled invented demo has nonlinear supports; under K-D5 on the converged active set (DEL-04-01 Design/kd5-nonlinear-active-set.md section 5) its converged support states are confirmed and its cases are published NUMERICAL_INTEGRITY_CHECKS_PASSED with certified rows (745 in each mode), so the demo is Current and its result export is offered, as before K-D5's nonlinear fail-closed rule (the milestone stays Sensitive and not offered). The model hash is computed by run.mjs from each file (RFC 8785 JCS, SHA-256), independently of the app.
